name: sc036-artifacts-zero-churn
description: 036 T076, FR-009/US2 AS1 — the zero-churn floor, compared across the two ports. Run 1 creates the tickets and publishes every artifact; run 2 revises spec.md alone, because run 1 stamped its identity marker into that file; run 3 is the genuinely unchanged one and must issue ZERO attachment, comment and manifest writes. The steady state is the THIRD run, not the second, and a scenario asserting on run 2 would be asserting against the marker write rather than against this feature. What is compared is the whole call sequence of all three runs, per run, so a port that churned on run 3 diverges on calls.log.2 alone while everything else stays identical.
